scenarioFamilies.title: Direct Mini-initiated trade to buyer funding
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Same authenticated agreement ID/version, participant and obligation; no local draft as funds

scenarioFamilies.title: Store Pay button opens SecurePay and returns safely
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Server-owned order/seller/quantity/amount/version; return alone never confirms funding

scenarioFamilies.title: Accommodation booking opens the same SecurePay checkout
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Host-held room/dates, cancellation terms and expiry independently valid before confirmation

scenarioFamilies.title: M-Pesa pending customer/provider action
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: No invented STK and no provider-pending state treated as verified funded

scenarioFamilies.title: Choice Bank simulated funding branch
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Only simulated bank option until provider/authorised backend eligibility confirmed

scenarioFamilies.title: PesaLink simulated funding branch
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Only simulated bank transfer until provider/authorised backend eligibility confirmed

scenarioFamilies.title: Price, dates, quantity or Agreement version changed
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Stale agreement/quote rejected; fresh explicit review; no trust in browser price

scenarioFamilies.title: Duplicate clicks, weak network and unknown provider result
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: One intent/effect per idempotency key; unknown blocks blind duplicate charging

scenarioFamilies.title: Close, reopen or resume same checkout
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Canonical status restored from API; popup close or URL cannot mark paid

scenarioFamilies.title: One cart spans multiple independent merchants
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Distinct seller obligations and allocations, no release crossing merchant lines

scenarioFamilies.title: Partial or delayed service/delivery
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Provider-confirmed funding differs from fulfilment and release or settlement

scenarioFamilies.title: Cancellation, refund or expiry after checkout
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Return/refund status requires genuine authorised backend evidence

scenarioFamilies.title: Forged host, spoofed return, reused session and cross-site attempt
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Fail closed on unregistered host, expired token and forged callback; no data leakage

scenarioFamilies.title: Small-value trade economic viability and clear charge
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Actual server quote/eligible fees visible before authorisation; no hidden surcharge

scenarioFamilies.title: First-time older/lower confidence user completes checkout
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: Uncoached action, readable labels, safe back/error states, no forced KS001 chat

scenarioFamilies.title: Same trader returns as needs evolve
scenarioFamilies.criticalInvariant: No duplicate accounts or wallets; preserve canonical work and historic results

requirements: Host server owns price, offer, exact seller and version; never price authority from Mini URL
Mini opens from a host Pay action into the same canonical Agreement context
Three rail simulations can be compared; none constitutes bank or mobile payment
Close/pending/failed/unknown returns to exactly that Store order without fabricated paid status
Stale offer or unregistered host is rejected
ShortStays server controls date/room availability, reservation expiry and cancellation conditions
Mini opens from Book/Pay into the same canonical Agreement context
Three rail simulations can be compared; no funds or accommodation reservation falsely confirmed
Unknown/close/reopen returns to the same booking request and respected hold expiry
Expired stay hold or unregistered host is rejected

blockers.title: Hosted Money Session FUND semantics versus provider PaymentIntent compatibility
Canonical Store order and ShortStays booking → Agreement binding
End-to-end enabled KS001, authenticated agreement acceptance and return evidence
